subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish own a warmed snapshot-fork workspace backend for issue workers, and should that use mitos directly or wait for a crabbox lease primitive?
rationale: Current main has target-checkout plumbing but no warmed pool; choosing the backend, rollout mode, cache policy, and isolation contract is an architecture decision rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Design opt-in warmed leases
options.body: Specify an opt-in warmed lease contract with isolation, cache invalidation, cleanup, and ordinary-checkout fallback before implementation.

options.title: Wait for external primitive
options.body: Keep current temporary checkouts until mitos or crabbox exposes a stable primitive, then track only Clownfish integration.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Close or defer the request if maintainers decide warmed fork orchestration belongs entirely outside Clownfish.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in warmed leases
recommendation.body: Specify an opt-in warmed lease contract with isolation, cache invalidation, cleanup, and ordinary-checkout fallback before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest current history in the checkout and executor lifecycle paths this feature would need to change.
